LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — her far arm, on the image's left side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.

GAZE: she looks into the camera.

separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; where the place is busy, a few background people may share the scene — same ground, light and style, sized for their distance, busy with their own activity, never facing the camera or posing beside her; quiet or private places stay empty. HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may leave the frame past the forearm, never floating without its arm; fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
